chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and I was with Abu Baseer, so I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and he (peace be upon him) was saying: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The fragrance of the perfume strengthens the heart and increases in the copulation'.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of using perfume according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Reported in al-Kafi through the chain of Sahl ibn Ziyad, this hadith links the Prophet’s statement to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), emphasizing the holistic benefits of perfume in Shia tradition. It underscores how pleasant scents not only elevate spiritual composure by 'strengthening the heart' but also enhance physical intimacy, reflecting the Islamic appreciation for both inner purity and outward beauty.
